sloka: अथ मासे तु सम्पूर्णे पूर्णेन्दुसदृशाननः ।प्रजापतिसुतः श्रीमाञ्छयने प्रत्यबुध्यत ।। ७.८९.९ ॥
transliteration: atha māse tu sampūrṇe pūrṇendusadṛśānanaḥ ।prajāpatisutaḥ śrīmāñchayane pratyabudhyata ।। 7.89.9 ॥

translations.english: Then, when the month was complete, the glorious son of Prajapati, whose face was like the full moon, awoke on his bed.
